revised_teaching_units.scope: Run two independently owned local process groups and separately verify that A stops and B can still produce its report.
revised_teaching_units.observation: A ignores TERM through the grace period, exits with signal 9 after group KILL and its pipe closes. B remains running and then produces amount 37. Container lifecycle and production isolation need target validation.
